summary.text: Amy Parks is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 51 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Jacki Marsh.
She previously represented the district in the Colorado House from November 2022 to January 2023 and works in communications.

paragraphs.text: Amy Parks graduated from Pahoa High School and received a bachelor's degree from the University of Hawaii in 2006.
She assumed office as a member of the Colorado House of Representatives for District 51 on November 28, 2022, and left office on January 9, 2023.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mom and communications professional from Loveland.
Parks said affordability is her top priority, and that she would defend TABOR and push back on mandates, fees and rules that raise the cost of living.
She also said her experience as a caregiver and advocate for her children in health care and education systems led her to focus on parents making decisions for their children.
